title: Creep Learns Why Stalking Teen Girls Is A Bad Idea
description:
Bodycam footage captures a terrifying confrontation in Yavapai County, Arizona after residents took matters into their own hands to stop a man they believed was stalking a teenage girl. Deputies responded just after 8 p.m. on February 2, 2023, after a family reported that 48-year-old Dustin Brown had been lurking outside their home despite an active attempt to serve him with an injunction against harassment.
